title: Chapter 27 Half An Hour Of Life And Death
content:
Chapter 27 Half An Hour Of Life And Death

I quickly contacted the player named Zhang Guangwen.

But he was fooled by the other party. He didn't have any scrolls at all. He just couldn't stand that he had made too much money recently, so he deliberately tricked him.

Wang Shuo was so angry. This player was already on Wang Shuo's blacklist. If there was a chance in the future, he would definitely make him look bad.

After waiting for a long time, Liu Dahai contacted him.

"I have a scroll for making speed-up here."

Wang Shuo was ecstatic and quickly replied: "How do you want to exchange it?"

"You seem to be in a hurry, but this is an intermediate scroll, which can play a huge role at a critical moment. How about 50 gold coins?"

This is the critical moment!

"I only have 20 gold coins now, and I will give you 15 bronze keys. What do you think?"

"Okay, deal."

The scroll was in hand, but it could only speed up for half an hour.

Wang Shuo's heart sank.

It seems that he can only hold on for half an hour.

I don't know if I can hold on for this half an hour.

He quickly took out the high-level crocodile leather armor and put it on. After the physique reaches 11 points, he can equip this leather armor.

He took the fine spear in his hand again. After the last battle with the crocodile, the durability was only half left. He had no way to repair the equipment at present.

He looked at the arrows. There were still some that had not been sold out last time, and there were more than 200.

He put on all the equipment that could enhance his combat effectiveness.

Wang Shuo was armed to the extreme.

Open [Character Information].

[ID: 5678 Wang Shuo]

[Level: Level 3]

[Strength: 11 (6+5)]

[Constitution: 21 (11+10)]

[Agility: 9 (6+3)]

[Stamina: 14 (13+1)]

[Health: 410]

[Defense: 20]

[Skills: 1. Make peace with mud, 2. Make mud pits, 3. Summon mud monsters. ]

[Equipment: 1. Fine spear, strength +5, attack +10, durability 10/10. ]

[Equipment: 2, advanced crocodile leather armor, gold quality, physique +10, defense +20, durability 100/100. Equipment requirements, basic physique 10. ]

[Equipment: 3, crocodile leather boots, excellent quality, agility +3, durability 20/20. ]

[Equipment: 4, rebound necklace: energy +1, can double the player's mental strength. ]

[Overall evaluation: You now have the strength to crush the beasts, go ahead! They will become the dead souls under your gun. ]

Wang Shuo felt stronger than ever before.

Now, there is a feeling of "one person guarding a city".

He stood outside the gate of the courtyard wall, quietly waiting for the arrival of the beasts.

The war was about to start.

At this time, Lord Zach posted a message in the lords' [chat channel].

"Lords, in the S area of the Novice Trial Space, player number SAC5678 has triggered the beast suppression mission in advance. Lords and city lords who are interested in selecting potential subjects can pay attention to it."

"Wow! This time there is a player who can force the beasts in the territory to jointly suppress it. It's not easy!"

"Yes, the game is only on the seventh day, and he has already built residential buildings. This speed is a bit exaggerated, but it's over!"

"I bet 500 gold coins, betting that this kid can't hold on until the final boss appears."

"Okay, Lord of the Earth, I accept this bet with you. I have been following him for a long time."

...

Wang Shuo naturally didn't know about these chat messages. He was tense and his face was cold at the moment.

He held the spear in his right hand and stuck it into the ground, looking forward. He seemed fearless and had a great momentum to look down on the world.

In fact, he was panicking.

The battle with the elite crocodile at least gave him some combat experience, at least he wouldn't be scared to death by the beast.

All I heard was a "quack, quack..." sound.

A group of magic frogs suddenly rushed over from a distance.

These magic frogs were of different sizes, some were as big as a head, and some were only as big as a fist. After a careful inspection, each monster had an ID.

Wang Shuo did not dare to despise them. He raised his hand and shot a magic frog directly.

"Are these beasts here to give experience?"

After Wang Shuo stabbed the magic frog to death, he felt that it was not difficult to kill it. This gave him an illusion that I was so strong?

The magic frog level was only level 1 to 2, and the health was only 10 to 20 points.

None of them could block Wang Shuo's shot.

His current attack power was indeed a bit overwhelming for this kind of magic frog that was only worthy of being a vegetable, but there were a lot of magic frogs.

The arrow tower was also continuously outputting, and this kind of magic frog with extremely low health could be killed with one arrow.

[Energy Crystal +1]

…

Wang Shuo kept rushing left and right, turning and moving. Every time he thrust his spear out, he would definitely take the life of a magic frog.

The magic frogs were not completely without attack power, but their attack method was to shoot out their tongues.

Although it was difficult for Wang Shuo to hide in the group of magic frogs, his defense power had reached more than 20, and these injuries could basically be ignored.

In less than ten minutes, Wang Shuo killed more than 200 of them, and the arrow tower was even more powerful, directly killing 500 of them.

The number of magic frogs gradually decreased, and at this time the mud monster also landed in Wang Shuo's territory.

As soon as it came into contact with it, it spit "saliva" at Wang Shuo.

Soon Wang Shuo was dyed into a "black man".

Wang Shuo endured the stench and used "mud-smoothing".

However, there were too many of them and they were soon surrounded.

He had to use a move called "Sweeping the Thousands" to clean up the monsters around him.

Then he retreated into the courtyard gate.

Quickly jumped onto the wall.

He continued to clean up the mud monsters, and at this time, the crocodiles also began to appear.

Although the number was far less than that of the magic frogs and mud monsters, the danger was much higher, which was one of the reasons why Wang Shuo jumped onto the wall.

The crocodiles had no way to attack Wang Shuo, but the magic frogs and mud monsters could, and the mud monsters could also corrode the walls.

This made Wang Shuo's heart sink. If the wall he was standing on was corroded, he would be surrounded again, and this time with the siege of crocodiles, he would be in danger.

Wang Shuo assigned the attack of the arrow tower to the crocodiles, and an average of 2 arrows could kill one.

This was good news.

The mud monsters were not easy to deal with, because Wang Shuo's mental power was quickly used up, and the recovery speed was completely unable to keep up.

For a while, Wang Shuo fell into a bitter battle.

"There are still 3 minutes." Wang Shuo silently calculated the time.

Seeing that the wall under his feet was about to collapse, Wang Shuo quickly changed a section of the wall.

Suddenly, the durability of the exquisite spear in his hand was exhausted and shattered.

Wang Shuo took out the bow and arrow again and continued to attack the crocodile.

The effect of using bows and arrows on the mud monster was too poor, and the number of magic frogs was almost killed.

In the distance, a huge mass of mud, as if with a positioning device, sprayed on Wang Shuo, directly knocking off 20 of his health points, which scared him.

Looking up, it turned out to be a huge mud monster, and Wang Shuo shot an arrow at it.

After checking the system prompts, Wang Shuo learned the information of the huge mud monster.

[Mud Monster Leader: ID Mud 00001 Earth Wave, Level SS, HP 2500/2500, Skills: Mud Spray, Swamp Creation, Fire Attraction. 】

Wang Shuo took a breath of cold air.

Level 3 vs Level 9, don't even think about it.

Wang Shuo was not sure about facing such a monster head-on.

He quickly retreated and jumped to another section of the wall to avoid it.

The wall was already riddled with holes. Fortunately, Wang Shuo attracted all the hatred, otherwise his house would have been lost.

The arrows in the arrow tower had been shot out. There were at least hundreds of magic frogs, more than 50 crocodiles, and countless mud monsters in front of him.

At this time, the only one who surrounded Wang Shuo was the mud monster leader, but there might be other bosses.

Wang Shuo was in a desperate situation for a while.
